versions.changelog:
**Initial public release of AI ROI Audit skill:**

- Provides a structured AI spend audit framework, focused on measurable business outcomes, not just usage or vendor stats.
- Outputs clear per-tool verdicts (keep/consolidate/renegotiate/cut) with supporting evidence and measurement confidence.
- Includes a hidden-cost ledger and requires explicit conversion assumptions for time and cost savings.
- Delivers a baseline measurement plan for any "unknowns" to enable better audits in the future.
- Implements strict quality checks and anti-patterns to ensure credible and actionable ROI analysis.
